title: Sziget Festival: The Island of Freedom Becomes Global
grammar: Colloquial intensifiers and discourse particles (*tök, marha, irtó, csigavér, noha*)
goal: I can say how the Diáksziget of 1993 became the Sziget Festival.
I can use *tök jó*, *marha nehéz* and *csigavér* in informal speech and know to avoid them in formal writing.
I can report what visitors say about the Sziget, naming whose view it is.
